item.title: Gelato: A Creamy Blend of Euphoria and Relaxation - Green Coast Radio
item.description: Embark on a Flavorful Journey with Gelato Gelato, known as "Larry Bird," "Gelato #42," and other variants, is a slightly indica-dominant hybrid, born from a crossing of Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint Girl Scout Cookies. This evenly-balanced strain (55% indica/45% sativa) is adored for producing a euphoric high that is both relaxing and mentally stimulating.
